description: persist an authored-by-value Movement Design Packet and Phrase Design Ledger for a specific movement. The calling agent authors both documents and passes them in `packet_content` and `ledger_content`.
embedding_description: Persist an authored Movement Design Packet and Phrase Design Ledger for a baroque keyboard movement. The calling agent writes both documents and passes them by value. The packet commits movement-level formal argument, harmonic route, motif material, and texture plan. The ledger translates these into per-phrase continuity obligations (formal_function, cadence_type, motif_directive, entry/exit anchors) that the WBS binds into compose_baroque_phrase steps.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Movement Design Packet and Phrase Design Ledger stored
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The Movement Design Packet and Phrase Design Ledger have been stored and are now available as working context. Continue executing the current step as shown in the updated ACTIVE_PLAN.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Persisting an authored-by-value Movement Design Packet and Phrase Design Ledger. create_movement_design accepts {manifest_id, movement_type, packet_content, ledger_content}. The calling agent must author both full documents and pass them by value — the platform never generates them. The platform generates packet and ledger ids.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: authored_content_required: `packet_content` or `ledger_content` was missing or empty — the thinking-model authoring path was retired (DEP-01); author both full documents and pass them by value. ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema, or a `##` section exceeds the size limit. StorageError: knowledge base write failed. ParameterError: manifest_id or movement_type is missing.
